backend/main.mo: Motoko backend handling public inquiry submissions and admin-restricted retrieval plus user profile management using AccessControl.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report linking deployment-related files, components, and requirement REQ-16.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Pre-written summaries of all frontend files for reference in build planning.
frontend/GO_LIVE_VERIFICATION.md: Deployment go-live checklist covering build verification, route checks, CTAs, SEO files, forms, auth, and responsiveness.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind-based global styling with OKLCH color tokens for light and dark modes.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point defining metadata, page title, and root mount for the frontend app.
frontend/public/robots.txt: Robots.txt allowing all crawlers and pointing to sitemap.xml.
frontend/public/sitemap.xml: Sitemap listing main hash-based site routes for search indexing.
frontend/src/App.tsx: React app router setup using hash history with routes for all public pages, admin page, and 404 handling.
frontend/src/components/auth/AdminGate.t: Wrapper that enforces Internet Identity login before rendering admin-only content.
frontend/src/components/inquiry/InquiryF: User inquiry submission form with validation, success/error states, and backend submission hook.
frontend/src/components/layout/Footer.ts: React footer component showing company info, navigation links, and contact links using businessContact config.
frontend/src/components/layout/Header.ts: Responsive header with logo, navigation, contact buttons, and mobile menu toggle.
frontend/src/components/layout/SiteLayou: Layout wrapper that renders Header, Footer, and page content.
frontend/src/config/businessContact.ts: Defines business contact details and helpers to generate phone, email, and WhatsApp links.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages authenticated or anonymous actors, refreshing queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminInquiries.ts: React-query hooks for fetching inquiries and checking admin status using the actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Internet Identity provider and hook managing authentication, login flow, and identity state.
frontend/src/hooks/useSubmitInquiry.ts: Mutation hook for submitting inquiries and invalidating the inquiries list.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind base styles and custom theme variables for light and dark modes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: App entry point setting up React Query and InternetIdentityProvider before rendering App.
frontend/src/pages/AboutPage.tsx: Renders the About page with company overview text and a values grid using cards and icons.
frontend/src/pages/AdminInquiriesPage.ts: Admin page that fetches and displays customer inquiries with loading, error, and empty states.
frontend/src/pages/ContactInquiryPage.ts: Contact page showing business contact methods and an inquiry form.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Homepage with hero banner, feature highlights, and product category previews.
frontend/src/pages/NotFoundPage.tsx: 404 page displaying a not‑found message and a button to return home.
frontend/src/pages/ProductsCategoriesPag: Displays product categories with images, descriptions, and lists of items in each category.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers to read URL parameters (including hash routes), persist them in sessionStorage, and remove them from the hash.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom colors, typography, container settings, animations, and plugin integrations.
project_state.json: Stores the project’s state, features, requirements, and architectural notes for the Krishna Traders web application.
